question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
-- Check if the tdr_overrides are duplicates or overrides
SELECT t.year, t.constructor_ref, t.driver_ref, t.team_driver_rank
FROM tdr_overrides t
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM team_driver_ranks td
    WHERE td.year = t.year 
    AND td.constructor_ref = t.constructor_ref 
    AND td.driver_ref = t.driver_ref 
    AND TRY_CAST(td.team_driver_rank AS VARCHAR) = TRY_CAST(t.team_driver_rank AS VARCHAR)
)
LIMIT 10
